market.legacy_artifact_name_note: Paths containing the token spot are historical artifact names and do not define the underlying market.

timestamps.feature_available_time: latest source-minute availability in the five-minute bucket
timestamps.entry_time: first one-minute close in the next five-minute bucket, strictly after decision_time

triggers: absolute 15-minute taker-base imbalance at or above its shifted prior-30-day q=99 threshold
absolute five-minute return at or above its shifted prior-30-day q=99 threshold
prior-history volume z-score at or above 2.5
prior-history trade-count z-score at or above 2.5
15-minute realised-volatility ratio at or above 2.0 relative to its shifted prior-30-day median
post_trigger_filters: 15-minute cooldown, equivalent to three five-minute bars

flow_definition.source: Binance USDT-M Futures Kline taker-buy base volume

m1_return_efficiency_5.formula: abs(sum(one-minute close-to-close log returns, 5)) / sum(abs(one-minute close-to-close log returns), 5)

x_return_efficiency_288.formula: abs(sum(five-minute log returns, 288)) / sum(abs(five-minute log returns), 288)

nonfinite_rule: Robustly standardised non-finite values are mapped to zero after development-calibration median/IQR scaling and clipping to [-8, 8].
